aka: The Fissure of the Red Sight
trans_title: The Fissure of the Red Sight
introduction: 防偷窥仪器的红光在新公园（二二八公园）里穿梭——害怕被监视的石像、斑驳的墙壁、路上的污渍、历史的痕迹，唤醒著无法言喻的复仇计划，空中飞过的战机、蒋中正的眼皮下，身为物体存在历史空间中复活预言般的反击。In Taipei New Park, a woman uses a device meant to find hidden cameras but accidentally brings the park’s statues to life. These statues, linked to Taiwan’s colonial past, seem to rise to avenge a tragic plane crash during a 1964 national day’s military parade under Chiang Kai-shek’s military law.
